name: diesel_cycle_air_standard
title: Air-standard Diesel cycle with a 60 % efficiency target (THD R08 exercise 4)
summary: Theoretical (air-standard) Diesel cycle on ideal-gas Air with specific heats taken constant over each transformation and evaluated at its mean temperature: isentropic compression, isobaric heat addition, isentropic expansion, isochoric heat rejection. The exercise fixes the thermal efficiency at 60 % and solves for the maximum temperature of the cycle; the four states, the heat added, the net work and the mean effective pressure follow.
